patterns.name: Blob-triggered messaging flow
patterns.implementation: Stateful workflow with Azure Blob polling at 60 seconds

patterns.name: Flat-file disassembly
patterns.implementation: Built-in Flat File Decoding action configured with annotated InventoryFlatFile.xsd and source BTP semantics

patterns.name: Dedicated subscription boundary
patterns.implementation: Configured Blob path activates only wf-inventory-update

patterns.name: Transport retry
patterns.implementation: Blob upload retries 3 times at PT5M

patterns.name: Managed identity
patterns.implementation: Workflow identity authorizes Blob and Key Vault
